title: Signed completion square on flat-term K-flat representatives
statement: For good cochain representatives P,Q [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined], let s be any chain map from their total tensor to the reversed total tensor with the homogeneous Koszul formula (-1)^(ij). The fixed quotient-normalized completionChain [def-sf-rational-verdier-data] intertwines Q(s) and the strict-system signed swap transported by the completed tensor model [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations], with the specified integralCompletedTensorComparison components. This is a one-field representative equation; no scalar extension, dualizing datum, constructibility or inverse completion comparison is assumed.

source.place: Paragraph 3, signed transposition and completion conjugation

proof.text: The pure tensor formula determines s by summand inclusions and sheaf tensor generators. In each positive quotient the strict signed swap has the same formula, and quotient images commute with the degree-product sign. The completion map has exactly these quotient coordinates and zero shifted mapping-fiber coordinate. Mapping-fiber coordinates and product projections detect equality, giving a compatible strict Roos chain square.

source.place: Paragraph 3, signed transposition and completion conjugation

proof.text: Apply the derived quotient functor and the full strict tensor-model normalization. The reduction-model comparison, strict-system braiding and reduction/limit adjunction express the completed map as completedSignedSwap conjugated by integralCompletedTensorComparison. This proves the stated derived representative equality. The calculation holds for zero complexes and the empty site as well.

theorem completion_signed_representative
    (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E X).FullSubcategory)
    (s : (constructibleTensorTotal l E X).obj (P.obj, Q.obj) ⟶
      (constructibleTensorTotal l E X).obj (Q.obj, P.obj))
    (hs : ∀ (i j : ℤ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (x : (P.obj.X i).val.obj U) (y : (Q.obj.X j).val.obj U),
      (s.f (i + j)).val.app U (IntegralHom.totalPair.{u, u}
        X (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) P.obj Q.obj i j U x y) =
        (i * j).negOnePow •
          (eqToHom (congrArg
            (fun k : ℤ ↦ ((constructibleTensorTotal l E X).obj (Q.obj, P.obj)).X k)
              (add_comm j i))).val.app U
            (IntegralHom.totalPair.{u, u} X
              (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) Q.obj P.obj j i U y x)) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.map s ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map ((completionChain D l hl X E).app (Q.obj, P.obj)) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((completionChain D l hl X E).app (P.obj, Q.obj)) ≫
        (integralCompletedTensorComparison l E X).inv.app (P, Q) ≫
        (completedSignedSwap l E X).hom.app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj) ≫
        (integralCompletedTensorComparison l E X).hom.app (Q, P)
